messages:
maya: Heads-up: I noticed a few accessibility and copy/QA things in the Retention preview modal in Console > Security. Filing here before I open a PR. Screenshot + flow in Figma: https://figma.com/s/retention-modal-v2 :eyes:

sam: What did you find?

maya: 1) Keyboard focus order is wrong: Tab goes region dropdown -> retention slider -> Apply, but the info tooltip (the small i icon that explains policy) is skipped. 2) The region fallback label currently shows 'Region: Auto' which has been tripping up support scripts. 3) KMS badge reads 'Managed key' but it's visually low contrast on light theme and reads like a button when it's not actionable.

robin: Agree on the tooltip focus. We should make the info-icon tabindex=0 and give it a visible focus ring. Also the slider needs aria-valuetext like 'Retention period, 90 days' rather than raw number.

jamal: For region label, can we use 'Region: Automatic (fallback)'? It's clearer for customers. But note tests and integrations expect 'Region: Auto' exact match. We need a deprecation plan if we change server side strings.

ana: FYI audit parsing: some legacy tools parse logs for 'Region: Auto'. If UI-only change, logs remain the same (server emits audit.region.fallback key). I'll open INF-1999 to coordinate. We should make the UI clearer while keeping audit keys stable for 2 release cycles before changing them.

sam: KMS badge: let's not make it look like a CTA. Proposal: keep the lock icon, change color to #0B5FFF for link text and use #0F1724 on the badge text for contrast. Add aria-label="encryption key status: managed". If it's actionable later we can switch to a button role.

robin: Sparkline inside the modal is an SVG with no <title>. Add <title> and role="img" so screen readers get a short description like: 'Retention usage preview: default policy 90 days, small sample'. Also ensure it isn't focusable for keyboard users unless it opens a larger view.

maya: Quick copy nit: the pill says '90d' 14. Could we show '90 days' on hover or expanded label? Audit teams prefer verbose copy in the UI but backend keys must remain stable. I'll add a hover showing the human readable string.

jamal: Tests: opening INF-2000 to update unit tests that assert 'Region: Auto'. We should coordinate deploy timing with QA.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/retention-modal-a11y (sha: def456) :package:

maya: I'll push a small PR for the tooltip focus & svg title + contrast tweaks. Will call out which changes are UI-only and which require backend keys to change. ETA: today.

ana: Adding security and audit reviewers to the PR. Also adding note in the release docs to warn customers about future audit string deprecation if we switch to 'Automatic (fallback)'.

robin: One more thought: keyboard users should be able to open the retention pill with Enter/Space (make it role=button). That gives parity with mouse users who can click the pill to expand the timeline.

maya: Good call. I'll make it role=button, add aria-expanded and visible focus styles. PR by EOD.

sam: Thanks team. After PR lands, let's run a quick axe scan and have QA exercise keyboard-only flow before merging.

jamal: I'll coordinate QA and test updates. Leaving comments on the Figma about the contrast and the hover copy.
